description: Give one app its own key and the calls it may make. Routes are rules like "GET /orders/:id", "POST /orders", "GET /users/{user}/orders" (per-user), or example calls like "GET /orders/42", which become rules allowing any id. Returns key (shown once), app.id and normalized rules. Send key as Authorization: Bearer <key> to the project gateway; never send the admin key to the workload.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

models.description: For a model API: the only models this app may ask for, exact names or a prefix ending in * (e.g. ["gpt-4.1-mini", "claude-haiku-*"]). Omit for no model limit.

name.description: The app name, e.g. "storefront" or "nightly sync"

per_minute.description: Calls per minute for this app (default 60)

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

routes.description: Only the calls this app makes, one "METHOD /path" per item

template.description: Ready-made API policy: reads allowed, risky writes held, destructive calls refused. Explicit routes replace the entire template policy. Free and Pro; configure the project upstream first. See /templates.

name: gate_add_app
title: Register an app
